findings.title: Await the asynchronous reschedule cleanup callbacks
findings.body: The async callbacks passed to forEach are discarded, so the surrounding try/catch cannot catch failures from the newly asynchronous getCalendar call, including module-loading and CalendarService-construction errors. Previously, synchronous initialization errors reached this catch; now they become unhandled promise rejections while Reschedule proceeds to send email and report success. Await Promise.all over a map, or use an awaited loop, so initialization and cleanup failures are handled. The same change is needed in packages/app-store/wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts.
